answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must perform unique Proof-of-Observation. Each agent registers by cryptographically hashing a distinct, live data pulse captured from a physical sensor wharf. This involves real-time analysis of complex inputs like pigment variations and temporal signatures, demonstrating control over unique, verifiable physical data sources or extreme real-time processing capabilities. Attackers face prohibitively high costs in replicating scarce physical infrastructure or dedicated computational resources per fake identity.
